# Juspay SDK Test Integration App

 ## Installation

 Clone the Android project.

 ```
 git clone https://github.com/juspay/payments-sdk-android-sample-integration.git
 ```

 ## Getting started

 Run the project using the latest version of [Android Studio](https://developer.android.com/studio).

 ## Adding/Modifying Maven URL

 SDK can be added/modified by adding the following repository in `build.gradle`

 ```
 maven { url "https://maven.juspay.in/jp-build-packages/hyper-sdk/" }
 ```

 ## Adding/Modifying the latest SDK

 SDK can be added/modified by adding the following dependency in `app/build.gradle`

 ```
 implementation 'in.juspay:hypersdk:2.0.0-rc.47'
 ```

 ## Modifying SDK Credentials

 SDK credentials can be accessed as constants in ```app/src/main/java/in/juspay/testIntegrationApp/PayloadConstants.java```

 <!-- ## Learn more

 [Juspay Integration Documentation](https://developer.juspay.in/) -->

                        <Button

                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:onClick="processJuspaySdk"
                            android:text="Process" />

                    </LinearLayout>

                </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

                <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
                    android:id="@+id/terminateCard2"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
                    android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
                    android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                    app:cardCornerRadius="4dp"

                    app:cardUseCompatPadding="true"
                    app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/processCard"
                    app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                    app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
                    app:layout_constraintVertical_bias="0.0"
                    app:layout_constraintVertical_chainStyle="packed">

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:padding="16dp"
                        android:orientation="horizontal">

                        <Button
                            android:layout_width="0dp"

                        <ImageView

                            android:tooltipText="@string/faq"

                    </LinearLayout>
                </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

                <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView

                    app:cardCornerRadius="4dp"

                    app:layout_constraintVertical_chainStyle="packed"
                    android:visibility="visible"

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:padding="16dp">

                        <TextView
                            android:layout_width="match_parent"

                    </LinearLayout>

                </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>


            </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

        </ScrollView>


    </LinearLayout>

</androidx.appcompat.widget.LinearLayoutCompat>

                        android:padding="16dp">

                        <TextView
                            android:layout_width="match_parent"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:text="@string/initiateDescV2" />

                    </LinearLayout>

                </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>



            </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

        </ScrollView>

        <Button
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_margin="16dp"
            android:onClick="startProcessActivity"
            android:text="@string/proceed" />

    </LinearLayout>

    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/processLayout"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:visibility="gone"
        tools:visibility="visible">

        <ScrollView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="0dp"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:fillViewport="true">

            <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginBottom="20dp">

                <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
                    android:id="@+id/generateOrderIdCard"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginTop="20dp"
                    android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
                    android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
                    app:cardCornerRadius="4dp"
                    app:cardElevation="4dp"
                    app:cardUseCompatPadding="true"
                    app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
                    app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                    app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
                    app:layout_constraintVertical_bias="0.0"
                    app:layout_constraintVertical_chainStyle="packed">

                            <LinearLayout
                                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                android:padding="16dp"
                                android:orientation="horizontal">

                                <Button
                                    android:layout_width="0dp"
                                    android:layout_weight="1.0"
                                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                    android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
                                    android:onClick="generateOrderID"
                                    android:text="@string/generate_order_id" />

                                <ImageView
                                    android:layout_width="60dp"
                                    android:layout_height="match_parent"
                                    android:padding="4dp"
                                    android:onClick="copyOrderID"
                                    android:contentDescription="@string/copy"
                                    android:tooltipText="@string/copy"
                                    android:src="@drawable/ic_action_copy"
                                    android:tint="@color/colorPrimary" />

                                <ImageView
                                    android:layout_width="60dp"
                                    android:layout_height="match_parent"
                                    android:onClick="showOrderIdFAQ"
                                    android:tooltipText="@string/faq"
                                    android:padding="2dp"
                                    android:contentDescription="@string/faq"
                                    android:src="@drawable/ic_faq" />

                            </LinearLayout>

                </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

                <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
                    android:id="@+id/signProcessCard"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
                    android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
                    android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                    app:cardCornerRadius="4dp"
                    app:cardElevation="4dp"
                    app:cardUseCompatPadding="true"
                    app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/generateOrderIdCard"
                    app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                    app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
                    app:layout_constraintVertical_bias="0.0"
                    app:layout_constraintVertical_chainStyle="packed">

                            <LinearLayout
                                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                android:padding="16dp"
                                android:orientation="vertical">

                                <LinearLayout
                                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                                    android:layout_height="wrap_content">

                                    <Button
                                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                        android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
                                        android:onClick="showProcessSigningInput"
                                        android:text="@string/input" />

                                    <Button
                                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                        android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
                                        android:onClick="showProcessSigningOutput"
                                        android:text="@string/output" />

                                    <ImageView
                                        android:layout_width="60dp"
                                        android:layout_height="match_parent"
                                        android:onClick="showSigningFAQ"
                                        android:padding="2dp"
                                        android:tooltipText="@string/faq"
                                        android:contentDescription="@string/faq"
                                        android:src="@drawable/ic_faq" />


                                </LinearLayout>

                                <Button
                                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                    android:onClick="signOrderDetails"
                                    android:text="@string/sign_order_details_payload" />

                            </LinearLayout>

                </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

                <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
                    android:id="@+id/processCard"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
                    android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
                    android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                    app:cardCornerRadius="4dp"
                    app:cardElevation="4dp"
                    app:cardUseCompatPadding="true"
                    app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/signProcessCard"
                    app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                    app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
                    app:layout_constraintVertical_bias="0.0"
                    app:layout_constraintVertical_chainStyle="packed">

                            <LinearLayout
                                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                android:padding="16dp"
                                android:orientation="vertical">

                                <LinearLayout
                                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                                    android:layout_height="wrap_content">

                                    <Button
                                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                        android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
                                        android:onClick="showProcessInput"
                                        android:text="@string/input" />

                                    <Button
                                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                        android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
                                        android:onClick="showProcessOutput"
                                        android:text="@string/output" />

                                    <ImageView
                                        android:layout_width="60dp"
                                        android:layout_height="match_parent"
                                        android:onClick="showProcessFAQ"
                                        android:tooltipText="@string/faq"
                                        android:padding="2dp"
                                        android:src="@drawable/ic_faq" />


                                </LinearLayout>

                                <Button
                                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                    android:onClick="processJuspaySdk"
                                    android:text="Process" />

                            </LinearLayout>

                </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

                <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
                    android:id="@+id/terminateCard2"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
                    android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
                    android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                    app:cardCornerRadius="4dp"
                    app:cardElevation="4dp"
                    app:cardUseCompatPadding="true"
                    app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/processCard"
                    app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                    app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
                    app:layout_constraintVertical_bias="0.0"
                    app:layout_constraintVertical_chainStyle="packed">

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:padding="16dp"
                        android:orientation="horizontal">

                        <Button
                            android:layout_width="0dp"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_marginEnd="16dp"
                            android:layout_weight="1.0"
                            android:onClick="terminateJuspaySdk"
                            android:text="@string/terminate" />

                        <ImageView
                            android:layout_width="60dp"
                            android:layout_height="match_parent"
                            android:onClick="showTerminateFAQ"
                            android:tooltipText="@string/faq"
                            android:padding="2dp"
                            android:src="@drawable/ic_faq"
                            android:contentDescription="@string/faq" />

                    </LinearLayout>
                </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

                <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
                    android:id="@+id/processInfoCard"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
                    android:layout_marginEnd="12dp"
                    android:layout_marginTop="24dp"
                    app:cardCornerRadius="4dp"
                    app:cardElevation="4dp"
                    app:cardUseCompatPadding="true"
                    app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/terminateCard2"
                    app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
                    app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
                    app:layout_constraintVertical_bias="0.0"
                    app:layout_constraintVertical_chainStyle="packed"
                    android:visibility="visible"
                    tools:visibility="visible">

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:padding="16dp">

                        <TextView
                            android:layout_width="match_parent"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:text="@string/processDescV2" />

                    </LinearLayout>

                </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>


            </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

        </ScrollView>


    </LinearLayout>

</androidx.appcompat.widget.LinearLayoutCompat>
